card.summary: Everything, $0 forever: Unlimited concurrent tunnels, Unlimited bandwidth and requests, Private VPN over WireGuard, No card, no trial, no expiry

record.category: udp port forward plus relay WireGuard (hosted)

free_tier.stated: Everything, $0 forever: Unlimited concurrent tunnels, Unlimited bandwidth and requests, Private VPN over WireGuard, No card, no trial, no expiry

egress.terms: Unlimited bandwidth and requests, with 'Bandwidth is fair-use guidance, not a meter - we don't throttle or bill per-GB.'; ingress: udp

record.interface_detail: mytunnel udp 51820 --public-port 31099, mytunnel wg up, and a REST API at login.21tunnel.com/api
record.tooling: mytunnel CLI, systemd unit, REST API
record.chaining: Provides a WireGuard endpoint with a reserved UDP port, composable with an external virtual machine.

limits.value: fair-use guidance only, no meter and no number

record.binding_note: As published, nothing binds: unlimited bandwidth, 60-second per-source idle window that matches WireGuard keepalive. That is the published figure. The service is not reachable, which is a stronger failure than any constraint.

identity_cost.detail: 'mytunnel login' opens a browser and saves a 90-day token; signup is at login.21tunnel.com, which does not resolve (see notes)

record.reliability_note: the documented relay and dashboard hostnames do not exist in DNS as of 2026-10-23; the marketing site is a static Cloudflare page
record.confidence_note: Service status is measured: agent.21tunnel.com and login.21tunnel.com both returned DNS status 3 (NXDOMAIN) for A and AAAA from Cloudflare DNS-over-HTTPS on 2026-10-23, while 21tunnel.com resolved on the same zone.

evidence.proved: 'It's free. All of it.' - unlimited tunnels, unlimited bandwidth and requests, Private VPN over WireGuard, no card, no trial, no expiry
reserved public UDP port, generated wg0.conf with Endpoint agent.21tunnel.com:31099, 'Free on all plans'
'WireGuard endpoint behind NAT' with 'mytunnel udp 51820 --public-port 31820' and a 60-second idle window'
DNS status 3, NXDOMAIN, no answer record; the same query for 21tunnel.com returns status 0 with 172.67.170.252 and 104.21.87.222
DNS status 3, NXDOMAIN, for A and AAAA; a direct HTTPS request to login.21tunnel.com from this host returns no status code and no remote IP
'We're newer, and we're up-front about it - MVP-stage', which is consistent with docs published ahead of deployment

record.notes: The best-designed free WireGuard ingress and the only provider that ships the .conf, the reserved UDP port and a WireGuard recipe together. It is not running. The wildcard caveat that applies to playit (a bare subdomain legitimately NXDOMAIN while a wildcard serves) does not apply here because login.21tunnel.com is a named host, not a wildcard member.

extras.wg_detail: the vendor documents the full path: '21tunnel reserves a public UDP endpoint and relays datagrams to it', clients get a .conf with 'Endpoint = agent.21tunnel.com:31099', and 'mytunnel udp 51820 --public-port 31099' is the exact relay command; 'Free on all plans.' https://21tunnel.com/docs/private-vpn/
extras.volume_stated: Unlimited bandwidth and requests, with 'Bandwidth is fair-use guidance, not a meter - we don't throttle or bill per-GB.'
extras.transit_note: the relay would carry the datagrams; as of this reading there is no relay to carry them
